domain.text: Worker-lock contention and durable wake delivery

impressions.text: The task addressed worker wake failures when status polling holds a per-PR lock.
The worker implemented retries for brief contention and queued wakes for sustained contention, with regression tests for both paths and reported passing test, typecheck, format, and CI checks.
The worker initially stopped because the two required regression tests were missing; the orchestrator asked for them, after which the worker reported them added and marked the work ready for review.
